local_context.value: Kiawah Island is a town in Charleston County; elevation 7 ft; full-time population 2,013 (2020 census), over 10,000 in the busy season. 37.3% of residents were 65 or older in the 2000 census (no 2020 figure found). Hurricane Hugo (1989) is cited in the article as a turning point for the resort.

neighborhoods.value: Eugenia; Cougar Point (formerly Marsh Point); Freshfields Village; Kiawah Island Club

place_entities.value: The Ocean Course (hosted the 2012 and 2021 PGA Championships); Kiawah Beachwalker Park (Charleston County Parks, west end of the island); Freshfields Village; Bass Pond Site and Arnoldus Vander Horst House (National Register of Historic Places)
place_entities.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiawah_Island,_South_Carolina (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14) · https://ccprc.com/3590/Kiawah-Beachwalker-Park (Charleston County Park & Recreation Commission, via search result, read 2026-10-14)

permit_office.value: Town of Kiawah Island Building Services Department issues building permits ("Issue permits for construction work"); apply and schedule inspections on the Town's Citizenserve portal; Town Hall 4475 Betsy Kerrison Pkwy, (843) 768-9166. (Separate Kiawah Island Community Association/ARB approvals exist; not an official-government source and not researched.)
